sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

One of the key features of Walter is its increasing difficulty level. As players progress through the levels, the obstacles and enemies become more challenging. This increasing difficulty level makes the game engaging and challenging, keeping players hooked for hours.

The game also features a variety of collectibles, including stars, coins, and hidden treasures. These collectibles can be used to unlock special power-ups, bonus levels, and other rewards. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Walter are engaging, challenging, and fun. The game's simplicity makes it accessible to young gamers, while its increasing difficulty level and variety of collectibles keep players engaged and motivated.
